edges: Veronica Mars is the main character of the episode.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Kitty rejoices in Chris's return to a state fit to be a soldier.
Chris returns to the estate thinking he is still twenty years old.
Chris fell in love with Margaret during a summer on Monkey Island.
Veronica helps Wallace with his final project.
Jenny and Kitty consult Dr. Anderson for Chris's treatment.
Kitty's husband Chris Baldry is fighting in World War I.
Dr. Anderson decides on a course of treatment with Margaret's help.
Veronica deduces that Jenny and her friends are responsible for creating fake student IDs.
Dick shows Logan a sex tape of Piz and Veronica.
